ideas.title: Investigating Medicaid Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: Investigate the Medicaid fraud in Minnesota and the effectiveness of the new pre-payment review system.
questions: How effective is the new pre-payment review system?
What are the consequences for those committing Medicaid fraud?
ideas.insight: This story is important because it highlights the vulnerability of the Medicaid system to fraud and the need for effective prevention measures. I will investigate the implementation of the new system and its impact on preventing fraud.
